description.en: Momo is a popular Nepali dumpling filled with minced meat or vegetables. It is usually steamed and served with spicy tomato chutney.
description.ja: モモは、ひき肉や野菜を皮で包んだネパールの人気料理です。一般的に蒸して調理し、辛いトマトチャツネを添えて食べます。

ingredients.en: Dumpling wrappers, minced chicken or vegetables, onion, garlic, ginger, coriander, salt, black pepper, and cooking oil.
ingredients.ja: 餃子の皮、鶏ひき肉または野菜、玉ねぎ、にんにく、しょうが、パクチー、塩、黒こしょう、食用油。

preparation.en: Mix the filling ingredients. Place a small amount in each wrapper and seal the edges. Steam for 10–15 minutes until thoroughly cooked. Serve with spicy tomato chutney.
preparation.ja: 具材を混ぜ、少量ずつ皮に包んで口を閉じます。火が通るまで10～15分ほど蒸し、辛いトマトチャツネを添えて食べます。
